title: Wayfare Rides Payment Collection Settings
content:
Collection of trip charges that fail on the rider's payment method follows the settings below on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**. They are the same on every ride option.

| Ride option | Automatic payment retries | Hours between retries | Unpaid trip amount blocks new requests and reservations |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Shared | 3 | 24 | Yes |
| Wayfare Standard | 3 | 24 | Yes |
| Wayfare Green | 3 | 24 | Yes |
| Wayfare Comfort | 3 | 24 | Yes |
| Wayfare XL | 3 | 24 | Yes |
| Wayfare Black | 3 | 24 | Yes |
| Wayfare Black SUV | 3 | 24 | Yes |

- **Automatic payment retries**: automatic retries of a failed trip payment before the amount is left outstanding, count.
- **Hours between retries**: hours between automatic payment retries.
- **Unpaid trip amount blocks new requests and reservations**: whether a rider with any unpaid trip amount may not request or reserve a new trip until it is settled (true/false).

On every ride option a failed trip payment is retried automatically 3 times, 24 hours apart, before the amount is left outstanding.
